_doc: Our only changes to the official templates. ui_steps run on the UI template before conversion; steps run on the converted API prompt. Every step says why.

steps.title: Save Audio (FLAC)
steps.why: lossless FLAC instead of MP3: MP3 adds encoder delay, which shifts frame-exact lip sync
keep the voice model on the GPU between jobs; unloading it after every line added about 7 s to each 3 s line (measured on the H200, 2 October 2026)

ui_steps.why: AudioCrop is not a ComfyUI 0.35 core node; we send voice samples already trimmed

steps.title: Save dialog mix (FLAC)
steps.why: lossless FLAC instead of MP3, as for tts

steps.title: Save speaker A (FLAC)
steps.why: the isolated track of speaker A drives the lip sync of A's shots

steps.title: Save speaker B (FLAC)
steps.why: the isolated track of speaker B
keep the voice model on the GPU between jobs; unloading it after every line added about 7 s to each 3 s line (measured on the H200, 2 October 2026)

steps.title: Save music (FLAC)
steps.why: lossless bed: the edit mixes and encodes once, at the end
